# r/UtahJazz (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the Utah Jazz stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Utah Jazz in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #57 Lauri Markkanen 56.8
- #102 Keyonte George 52.1
- #115 Jaren Jackson Jr. 51.0
- #118 Darryn Peterson 50.3 (rookie)
- #123 Jaxson Hayes 50.0
- #166 Jusuf Nurkić 46.2
- #170 Kyle Filipowski 45.9
- #252 Brice Sensabaugh 41.2

Rookies start from a draft-slot prior. GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
